notes.title: A Small Update about the state of the project
notes.content:
Hi guys, i just wanted to let you know that i recently restarted development on the
Inheritors. There's not much more to tell you for know but i just wanted to let you guys now.
I was mostly done when i stopped development so i shouldn't take too long to finish but i don't want
to make any more promises, sorry.

notes.title: Status Update 30/12/2019
notes.content:
A quick update! Beta testing coming soon, with full release coming
shortly after! You can expect more new coming in the following days but
i wanted to make a quick announcement to show everyone this project is
still alive, lol.
If i have some time, i'll update the store page and add a couple of more
current screenshots tomorrow. If i don't see you guys then, have a happy New Year!
Ah, and here's a picture of the definitive title screen if you haven't seen it already:
